name: blob worker capability path
expression: new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const source='postMessage({tag:Object.prototype.toString.call(self),window:typeof window,document:typeof document,crypto:typeof crypto,streams:typeof ReadableStream})';const url=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([source],{type:'text/javascript'}));const worker=new Worker(url);const timer=setTimeout(()=>reject(new Error('timeout')),3000);worker.onmessage=e=>{clearTimeout(timer);worker.terminate();URL.revokeObjectURL(url);resolve(e.data)};worker.onerror=e=>reject(new Error(e.message))})
